title: What's New in Revit 2025
summary: Revit 2027 new features for BIM managers: Autodesk Assistant, rule-based numbering, Tag by Example, and what to check before your firm upgrades.
body_markdown:
FAQ


## Frequently asked questions.


Can't find what you're looking for?
Get in touch .


### When was Revit 2027 released?


Autodesk released Revit 2027 in April 2026, announcing it on April 7, and recommended installing the 2027.0.1 update for its fixes. Two point releases followed: 2027.1 in June and 2027.2 in July 2026.


### What are the new features in Revit 2027?


The main ones are Autodesk Assistant (an AI assistant, in tech preview), rule-based numbering, production-ready Accelerated Graphics, walls hosted on walls, Issues built into Revit, and Forma tools included in the subscription. The 2027.1 and 2027.2 updates added Tag by Example, view title snapping, an MEP sizing calculator and Incremental Model Open, in tech preview.


### What is Autodesk Assistant in Revit?


Autodesk Assistant is an AI assistant inside Revit 2027 that works in plain language. Autodesk says it can answer questions about the model, create and organize views and schedules, edit parameters and manage rooms. It's a tech preview, and since 2027.1 its actions are logged in the Revit journal and marked with an AI prefix in the Undo menu.


### Will Autodesk Forma replace Revit?


Over time, Autodesk says yes. Its September 2026 Autodesk University FAQ says more of the design, analysis, coordination and documentation done in Revit today will move into Forma, Autodesk's industry cloud for AEC. Autodesk also says it won't force a sudden transition and will keep investing in Revit, and it has given no date for the transition. Revit 2027 already shares data with Forma as a Forma Connected Client.


### What are the system requirements for Revit 2027?


Revit 2027 runs on 64-bit Windows 11 and .NET 10. Autodesk lists 16 GB of RAM as usually enough for a single model up to about 300 MB on disk, with more for larger models. Check Autodesk's system requirements page for graphics and disk space.


### Does Mira work with Revit 2027?


Yes. Mira, the AI agent for Revit, supports Revit 2025 and later, including Revit 2027. It's free to download from the Mira page.
